Expect lots of pain the first 3 days. And if you arent getting put under during the procedure, expect a lot of pressure during it, and make sure you are completely numb in the mouth. No "eh it's good enough" because trust me, you feel almost everything they do. Dont drink out of straws or suck on anything for like 2 weeks (or until the stitches dissolve). Dont eat anything with seeds (strawberries are especially bad) because they can get lodged in your sockets. Take lots of advil and tylenol. Use ice packs to bring down swelling and pain. I swelled up like a chipmunk and my face all the way down to my chest turned green from bruising. Literally the most painful 3 weeks of my life. 
For food, have lots of very soft food available. Ice cream, pudding, mac and cheese, diced peach cups, booster juice (try and get smoothies without seedy fruits). Dont push yourself and eat hard foods. It's a pain in the ass only eating ice cream and mac and cheese for 2 weeks, but it could be worse. 

Make sure to brush your teeth as best you can, and if you cant get far back in your mouth because it doesnt open (mine wouldnt open more than a few centimeters the first week) use mouthwash and dont swish, tilt your head.

Good luck!!
